tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find ordinary and artist cards by artwork, occasion, format or budget. Returns matches with exact design keys and versions, images, orderability, destination prices and next_cursor. Pass destination_country when known; read pricing_destination and cents_by_destination. Basic physical specifications

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepare one unpaid purchase of 1 to 500 cards, with mixed artwork, formats, messages, recipients, occasions and dates in one cards array. Each card is priced for its recipient country. Returns order.cards, the exact total, a private order_access_token and review_url for buyer review and payment. Whe

tools.name: read_order
tools.description: Read one known private purchase using its order ID and matching capability. Returns the current revision, payment state and order.cards with each card’s production and mailing states. Use it to check progress or refresh a stale revision; it does not change the order.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an eligible purchase or eligible paid cards at the current order revision. Before payment, omit card_ids for whole-purchase cancellation. After payment, omit them for the whole eligible purchase or select returned card IDs. The service checks ownership and each fulfillment cutoff, then return

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Optionally record a technical problem, suggestion or neutral successful outcome using fixed choices. Use after communicating the outcome to the buyer; never required to buy a card. Reports are stored for 30 days and deduplicated daily. Returns recorded or duplicate; TRY_LATER means the daily limit o

tools.name: revise_order
tools.description: Replace an unpaid draft before payment starts. Send the complete desired cards array, including unchanged cards. Validation and replacement are atomic: failure leaves the original draft intact; success cancels it and returns a new order, price, private token and review_url. Use that replacement for

tools.name: preview_card
tools.description: Show a prepared card’s finished surfaces before payment when preview_available is true. Optional, never required to buy. Returns images and their order revision, plus preview_url for clients that need a browser. Preview again after changes. This does not change, charge or mail the order.

tools.name: open_private_content
tools.description: Open a private upload scope for the buyer’s photo, artwork, logo or QR card. Omit both inputs for a new scope, or pass an unpaid order and its token to reopen that draft’s scope. Returns scope_id, a private token, upload_url and expiry. Assistants cannot upload conversation attachments; send the buy

tools.name: read_private_content
tools.description: List assets and existing card compositions in one private scope after the buyer uploads. Returns asset IDs with their kinds and each composition’s design_key/version. Reuse an existing composition directly; use compose_private_card only for a new face. For a new purchase, prepare_order uses request_

tools.name: compose_private_card
tools.description: Create a new immutable card face from this scope’s artwork, logo or QR URL. Requires at least one of those inputs; a QR-only face needs no upload. Returns design_key and design_version for prepare_order or revise_order. Personal message, recipient and mailing details are supplied in the order’s card

tools.name: delete_private_content
tools.description: Request deletion of unused uploads and compositions in one private scope at the buyer’s request. Returns acceptance and deletion state; it does not cancel an order. Purchased content remains until 90 days after mailing or final cancellation/refund, longer while an order, dispute or legal hold is unr

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Start or resume payment for this exact prepared order and revision. Show the exact amount and returned action_url for the buyer to connect Link, approve this purchase or complete bank authentication. Only the buyer can approve; never ask for payment credentials in chat. Call again after that step, r

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Find orders first prepared through this assistant connection with history permission, newest first. Replacements inherit their original order’s history access; revising an unlinked order does not add it. Requires a connected buyer who granted orders:read; the public endpoint returns connection instr

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_cards" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find currently available ordinary and artist cards by occasion, tone, format, artist or budget. Public browsing needs no account or key." → after: "Find ordinary and artist cards by artwork, occasion, format or budget. Returns matches with exact design keys and versions, images, orderability, destination prices and next_cursor. Pass destination_country when known; read pricing_destination and cents_by_destination. Basic physical specifications "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
